name: MAL Sync
overview: Sync Jellyfin watch progress with MyAnimeList
description: Keeps your MyAnimeList watch progress in sync with what you've watched in Jellyfin. Supports per-user MAL accounts via OAuth 2.0 PKCE, live log streaming, dry-run mode, sequel chain resolution, and flexible scheduling.

versions.changelog:
A rebuilt interface, better matching, and a fix for imports that were only ever reported, never made.

INTERFACE
- Both pages share one design system, and follow Jellyfin's light and dark themes
- A checklist shows what still needs setting up and disappears once it is done
- Sections you cannot use yet explain why, instead of offering buttons that do nothing
- Runs end with a plain result — updated, skipped, errors, duration — and the raw log stays out of the way unless something went wrong. Runs can be stopped
- Plain-language labels throughout; advanced tools sit behind "More options"
- The plugin settings page is server settings only. Your own account, request rules and manual runs live on the MAL Sync page
- New Diagnostics tab: checks the MyAnimeList client ID and the Jellyseerr connection, shows scheduled task health, and names users whose imports would be skipped because Jellyseerr has no matching account

MATCHING
- Titles compare with punctuation and bracket noise removed, and also match when one is the leading part of a longer one or uses the same words in another order
- Episode count, media type and year weigh in alongside the title, so openings, specials and films stop winning matches, and a remake is told apart from the original it is named after
- Searches consider 15 candidates instead of 5
- Every season shows how it was matched: Auto, Yours, Not checked, No match, Needs split or Excluded — one coloured marker in the same place, with the detail underneath
- "No match found" used to also mean "never looked at". Those are now separate
- Episode counts name both sides: "8 of 12 episodes" when you have not downloaded everything, which is never treated as a fault, and "24 episodes here, 12 on MAL" when a season has outgrown its entry
- Matches cached without a title showed as a bare "MAL 59978"; titles are now stored, backfilled and filled in on the page

SEASONS SPLIT ACROSS SEVERAL MYANIMELIST ENTRIES
- A season holding far more episodes than its entry is detected during sync, and the split is worked out there and then — the warning arrives with the parts listed and an Apply button
- Detection no longer depends on MyAnimeList linking the parts as sequels; where the relations lead nowhere, later parts are looked up by name
- A split replaces a single entry rather than sitting beside it, which is how the sync has always treated it. The dialog now asks which of the two applies, instead of presenting both as separate settings

MYANIMELIST LINKS
- Every anime in the plugin links to its MyAnimeList page
- Series, season and episode pages carry a MyAnimeList link next to IMDb and TMDB, with no setup. Because item pages are shared while matches are per user, it appears only where all users agree
- An optional injectable script adds a per-user link to item pages

IMPORTS
- Jellyseerr answers with success even when it creates nothing, and that counted as a request. The same titles were therefore reported as imported after every run while never reaching Jellyseerr. A created request carries an id, and that now decides
- Seasons that have not aired are skipped instead of requested over and over; requesting a whole series asks only for the seasons that exist
- An import summary identical to the previous one is not sent again
- Jellyseerr calls get 60 seconds instead of 30, and a search that times out is retried once

FIXES
- Global settings, including the Jellyseerr API key, could be read and changed by any signed-in user. They are now restricted to administrators
- Saving server settings rewrote the sync task's schedule, undoing whatever was set under Scheduled Tasks
- Webhook and log messages were partly German, and some named a tab this release replaced
- Settings belonging to deleted Jellyfin accounts are cleared out instead of failing on every run

- New Settings tab: Personal Sync Settings and Push Notifications moved out of Sync tab into a dedicated tab
- Push Notifications: added Import Errors and Import Summary notification types
- Push Notifications: fixed webhook notification checkboxes not being saved or loaded
- Push Notifications: import webhook notifications are now actually sent after each import run
- Fix: log auto-scroll no longer fights the user when scrolling up during live output
- Fix: import log no longer hidden after switching from Preview mode to Import/Dry Run
- UI: removed max-width constraint on user page (uses full available width)
- UI: log panels always visible with placeholder text; no more hidden-until-clicked behaviour
- UI: consistent Dry Run button labels across Import and Sync tabs
- UI: series list in Manage tab is now scrollable (max-height 560 px)
- UI: full English localisation — all remaining German strings removed

- Fix S1/S2 mismatch in MAL title resolution (e.g. Baka & Test)
- Add S1 sequel-candidate rejection with fallback remap
- Reduce false sequel detection for titles ending in honorific '-san'
- Register MAL sync scheduled task correctly
- Respect configured sync trigger defaults instead of hardcoded task time

- Per-user MAL account page accessible via sidebar (Plugin Pages integration)
- Per-user sync setting overrides (never-downgrade, MAL→Jellyfin mark) with global fallback
- Admin banner on user page with link to global settings
- Dynamic username in MAL account card title
